channel.title: Appcellent: What's new
channel.description: New features and releases across Appcellent apps.

item.title: Stud Finder 3.1
item.description: Adjusting sensitivity is now easier: just slide your finger left or right. Plus, find quick answers to common questions in Settings.

item.title: Volume Booster 2.1
item.description: New on iOS 27: Boost All Apps makes Spotify, YouTube, Podcasts and your other apps louder too. Also new: Speaker Cleaner to help push out water and dust, a Louder iPhone Guide for hidden volume settings, a fresh look and fewer interruptions.

item.title: Decibel Meter 1.1
item.description: Now available in Finnish and Polish. A fresh new app icon, plus performance improvements and bug fixes.

item.title: Colorzy 1.2
item.description: Colorzy now speaks more languages. Plus smoother coloring and bug fixes.

item.title: Protractor 4.1
item.description: Protractor now speaks 13 more languages, including Danish, Dutch, Norwegian, French and Portuguese. Faster startup, no more tracking prompt, plus bug fixes and performance improvements.

item.title: TCG Vault 2.0
item.description: TCG Vault 2.0 is here! • Now on iPad and Apple Watch, plus Home Screen widgets for your vault value. • Wishlist: save the cards you want and get notified when they get cheaper. • Price alerts: pick a target price for any card. • Value chart: watch your collection's value change over time. • Import or export your binders as CSV files. • A fresh new look, a smarter scanner and offline support.

item.title: TCG Vault 1.8
item.description: • A smarter scanner that recognizes cards by their artwork — far fewer wrong matches. • Prices update every day, now including Cardmarket. • Bug fixes and faster loading.

item.title: Stud Finder 3.0
item.description: A fresh new look and faster metal detection. Plus a new Tools tab to help you hang pictures, mount your TV and more. Now on iPad, too.

item.title: Volume Booster 2.0
item.description: New: Siri & Shortcuts support, free sound-test tools and full iPad support. Faster loading and smoother playback.

item.title: Protractor 4.0
item.description: New specialized measuring modes — roof pitch, bubble level, inclinometer, body angle and more — plus full iPad support, new languages and accuracy improvements.

item.title: Volume Booster 1.5
item.description: Save your own custom EQ presets and recall them with a single tap, plus new shuffle and repeat modes for nonstop playback. Control play, pause, and skip right from your lock screen and headphones.

item.title: Decibel Meter launched
item.description: Decibel Meter arrived on the App Store.

item.title: TCG Vault 1.7
item.description: Variant-aware collections, smarter scanning, and quality-of-life improvements across the board.

item.title: TCG Vault 1.6
